In the example sources, approved covalent KRAS G12C inhibitors give objective response rates near 37 to 41 percent in previously treated patients [1]. Piperazine-linked quinazolines often inhibit hERG at low micromolar concentrations [2]. No resistance was seen in patients who progressed [3].
